batch.description: Visual transcription of the AdmissionWar/Google Drive solved-paper compilation scan of the JU D Unit 2015-2016 admission paper whose printed header reads SET CODE: 5 (Drive listing 'Set-2'). 80 questions: Chemistry 24 (Q1-24), Biology 44 (Botany 21, Zoology 23), Bangla 4, IQ 4, English 4 — subjects assigned by content (no headings printed); this set code runs Chemistry first. Keys are the compiler's printed উত্তরঃ boxes, not an official JU key. 17 questions are KEYLESS: the scan clips the right-hand key boxes of pp.2/4/6 at the page edge (Q20, Q49, Q50, Q52-58, Q76), one box is watermark-obscured (Q3), and five boxes print no legible letter (Q47, Q48, Q63, Q64, Q68) — no key has been guessed for any of them. A book-sourced pack of (apparently) the same printed paper already exists as ju-d-2015-2016-set5.json; this Drive-sourced pack is kept separate under the -drivepdf file suffix. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit (Faculty of Biological Sciences) 1st-year (Honours) admission test 2015-2016, SET CODE 5 — solved-paper compilation scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive)
sourceDocuments.notes: Scanned solved-paper compilation (aggregator watermark 'ADMISSION WAR' with 'তোমার সেরা গাইড' diagonal; footer 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com'; 'Scanned by CamScanner'). Each question carries a ব্যাখ্যা box with a boxed উত্তরঃ key. Renders: ocr/pages/jud1516s2/p-1..6.png (pdftoppm 300 dpi); p-1 render sha256 4032faf9e82570117bf0d3feb71ea095834e59e68eeb05b077ec33308b5ce47f. Render integrity was verified before transcription (fresh downscale read against locally generated tiles). The scan's right edge cuts through the key boxes of the right-hand columns on pp.2, 4 and 6; every affected box was checked on dedicated edge strips before being declared keyless.
